data.thought: We need a Python translation of the CR-001 scorecard model to compare against the exported bundle.

args.instructions: Write a Python module that implements the CR-001 scorecard. Define a class LegacyModel that loads the exported coefficients (9 coefficients) and any categorical encodings from the exported bundle, applies the same preprocessing as the R script, computes the linear score, applies the decision threshold, and returns a DataFrame with 'score' and 'decision' columns matching the exported bundle. The implementation must exactly mirror the R logic so that check_parity will succeed.
